payload.prompt: Task 36 review fix (one item). In app/leer/scene-page.tsx the wheel state lives in `useRef` inside ScenePage, but ScenePage remounts on every scene (the route renders it with key={sceneId}). So when a swipe turns from the last page of a scene to the next scene, the lock is lost and trackpad inertia immediately turns the new scene's page too, skipping pages. Move the wheel state to a module-level `let wheelState: WheelTurnState = { acc: 0, lockedUntil: 0, lastAt: 0 };` next to `enterAtEnd`, with a one-line comment why (survives scene remounts so one swipe never turns twice). Update the listener to read and write it. Nothing else. Run `npx vitest run app/folio` and `npm run typecheck`. Do not commit.
